title: Community Grieves Desecration of Child’s Grave at Georgetown’s Oldest Black Cemetery
creator: Jones, Christopher
description: This Georgetowner news article reports on the desecration of a child's grave at the Mt. Zion–Female Union Band Society Cemetery in Georgetown. It records the site's historical significance, community reactions to the desecration, and some of the broader challenges of preserving African American burial grounds.
